fusions.name: Rooted Stomp
fusions.desc: You plant your feet and stamp, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning them for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Landslide Shoulder
fusions.desc: A shoulder blow that deals 32 damage, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Stoneskin
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 30% for 10 seconds, and your physical resistance rises by 10%.

fusions.name: Bedrock
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, you gain a shield worth 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
